_readme: Human-vs-agent disagreement record for the corpus. A research agent drafts each row from public sources and proposes an adoption stage; a human reviewer then checks the row against those sources and accepts, revises, or removes it. This file counts what the reviewer did at that FIRST review (label_provenance); later corrections and evidence-dated transitions are listed under since_first_review and never folded into the rate. IMPORTANT: the reviewer saw the agent's proposed stage and its written reasoning before deciding, so these figures are ANCHORED, non-independent agreement and should not be read as an inter-rater reliability estimate. No kappa is reported here and none should be inferred. Re-read passes (data/rereads.jsonl) are summarised under rereads: who drafted the change cards, the scope, the direction checked and every decision; a re-read is anchored too. The confidence block compares the confidence the agent proposed with the confidence the reviewer set at first review (anchored too), and first_review_sessions sets both fields side by side per review date with the agent prompt version in force. Derived from data/institutions.json, data/not_classified.json, data/transitions.jsonl, data/rereads.jsonl and data/first_review.jsonl; rebuild with tools/build_agreement.py.

stage_agreement.basis: first review: label_provenance, set once when a human first ruled on the agent's proposal; later corrections and transitions do not move it

current_label.basis: agent_proposed_stage against the row's stage today; moves with corrections and evidence-dated transitions, so it is not the anchored first decision

matrix_note: first-review outcomes; a row revised and later corrected back is placed at its first-review stage when a re-read entry records it, and in no cell otherwise (stage_agreement.first_review_stage_undetermined counts those)

rereads.scope: every row at stage scaling when the pass began

confidence.basis: first review: the confidence the agent proposed against the confidence the reviewer set when first approving the row; anchored (the reviewer saw the proposal); confidence rates the public evidence for the stage, not label accuracy

withdrawals.reason: Initially listed, withdrawn on human review: a single usable source, limited to one business line, could not support a firm-level stage classification.

limitation: Anchored, not blind: the reviewer saw the agent's proposed stage and its rationale before deciding, and is also the author of the classification rules. The figures are not independent of the proposal; never read them as a reliability coefficient.
